messages.text: I looked at that Queens co-op listing you sent. The monthly maintenance alone is more than our first rent.
Do you still have that old senior-year file where you scored job options? Your cousin is asking how to compare first jobs.
Exactly. Fun to click around, but once I add the down payment and fees, it stops feeling like a real plan.
Maybe in Drive. It had rows like reporting assistant, ops data, training coordinator, and a few columns I made up.
Then keep your lease decisions simple. No reason to trap yourself because a website had nice photos.
Send only if useful. I remember you were very serious about steady pay and where the work could lead.
Yeah. I still want my subway map nearby, just not a 30-year decision attached to it.
I'll look tonight. The scoring was basic but it did stop me from chasing the fanciest-sounding tech listing.
Did you remember to soak the lentils before work?
Yes, they are simmering now. Rice is started too.
Good. Add a little turmeric and coriander after the onions soften.
Doing that, and I made enough dough for two flatbreads.
When you call Ammamma Sunday, ask if she still wants the pressure cooker gasket from Queens. She said the last one you brought fit perfectly.
I can ask. Is this the same size I packed when we stayed in Hyderabad?
Yes. Also practice saying the street name before you call her, otherwise she will correct you for ten minutes.
Beta, for the office lunch Thursday, wear the navy shirt if it still looks crisp. I can press it when you come Sunday.
Fair. I can handle her corrections and Dad's side asking why I still mix up the wedding-song words.
That one is fine. I left the two shirts in the online cart for now.
Good. For Diwali later, we will need to plan early too: family gifts, something nice to wear, and all the food trays.
Yeah, I started a separate list so November doesn't hit all at once.
Did you get dinner after work or only coffee again?
Real food, I promise. I made dal and rice at the apartment.
Good. Call after you finish the ConEd split with your roommate, not too late.
Will call around 9. Rent transfer went out this morning too.
You around for ten minutes? Keeping this out of the game chat.
Yeah, call me. I can pause the rent-thread doomscrolling.
Thanks. Ma saw my short replies and sent three lines about dinner, water, and whether my shirts are piling up.
Classic. Call now, then eat the dinner before she asks for proof.
I sent the building portal receipt. Your line is the same as last month plus the bedroom-size difference.
Got it. I just pushed 1,700 through Chase, and I'll send the ConEd/WiFi piece once those post.
Works. The common stuff looked almost exactly half when I checked.
Cool, I'll keep my March sheet under 3.4 if nothing else weird hits.
Did you see the LMS vendor change from yesterday? Stakeholder asked about it before 9.
Yeah, caught it in the morning app queue. I saved two pieces and one case-study PDF before the train went underground.
Useful. Can you drop the practical bits into the launch doc after standup?
Already clipped the section on completion metrics. Will add the part from the inbox digest too.
Can you look at the branch-choice screen before the 11:00 check-in? The compliance folks changed the wording again.
Yeah. I am updating the Storyline file now and will keep the first two panels as placeholders until Priya signs off.
Good. I will ask Priya to stay on the call for the scenario examples, then you can swap in the final text.
Also pulling last month’s quiz misses so the first draft is not just based on complaints from managers.
Still up for coffee after the 1:30 revision meeting?
Yes. If we go to the place by Jay St, I can jump on the F after and be near Dumbo before sunset.
Still okay for coffee near Bryant Park at 1:30? I can bring the vendor notes.
That works. You always stitch together three neighborhoods in one afternoon.
Yep. I have to send the March rent half from the office first, then I can walk over.
It beats sitting around between errands. Coffee, train, then a few minutes by the water.
Got it. Hope the building portal behaves better than our LMS.
It wants two separate logins every month, one for each name on the apartment account. Very elegant.
Stakeholder notes finally stopped coming in. Are you still at your desk?
Just closed the laptop. I am doing the green curry place by my stop and calling that dinner.
Fair. You survived the revision pile.
Trying to keep it to one entree, no extras. My app totals from the weekend were ugly.
Saturday Edison plan still okay? Anil said 1:30 works better for them.
Yes, I can meet you and Mom at Penn first and ride out from there.
Good. I booked the car for three from station. Priya may join from Hoboken if her shift ends early.
Perfect. I haven't seen that side since Diwali, so it'll be good to catch up.
Before buying a new router, check the cable from the wall and restart the little black box first.
Already did the wall cable. I heard your voice in my head making me do the simple checks first.
Good. Half the time it is the simple thing. Your mother used to say the same about forms at the clinic window.
Different desks, same patience for people who forgot one step.
Did you see that post I sent you about the new help desk automation tool?
Saved it. It came up right next to a thread about tracking course completion with cleaner dashboards.
Good. Keep the useful ones, ignore the noise.
Yeah, I keep a little folder now for posts worth rereading before work.
Can you bring the small brass lamp Saturday? Mine is still at Masi's after the last gathering.
Yes, I have it in the kitchen cabinet. Do you also need the kumkum box?
Bring that too. Your dad said he may stop for the singing first and then come for dinner.
Works. I'll come straight from Brooklyn with the lamp, kumkum, and the extra containers.
I found the blue folder from the Queens apartment. Your 11th grade immunization copy is in there with my old Osmania marksheets.
The one Dad kept in the hall closet near the router box?
Did you ever print the lamp photo from November? The one from your apartment window came out very nice.
I ordered two copies. Keeping one by my desk and sending you the other with the Sankranti recipe cards.
Yes, that one. He wrote our old 2014 address on the outside, so it should be easy to match with your school records.
Good. Also ask your dad which weekend he wants for April. He said the gurdwara program may be crowded.
Can you keep aside the campus pages too? I want to scan everything together this weekend.
I’ll check with him tonight. I don’t want to miss the April one again.
For the opener slide, do you have a short track you usually like using? We can add 10 seconds before the first prompt.
I do not really have a go-to for that. Maybe use the neutral clip from last launch if it still fits.
Works. I will keep it quiet under the narration so it does not distract.
Good call. The pacing matters more there than the clip itself.
Can you do the volunteer setup on Friday? HR wants the waiver uploaded before noon.
Yes, just finished it. The long health section was basically all blank boxes for me.
For the inclusion-module refresh, do you want me to keep the heritage-month photo carousel?
Great. They only asked because of the lifting and the stairs at the site.
Maybe shrink it. The part people keep asking about is why the promotion examples all use the same three managers.
That part is fine. I can take the stair shift and skip the coffee run.
Fair. Also saw your calendar block for Foley Sq later. Leaving early?
Just stopping by after work for a bit, then sending the $25 I promised to the Queens pantry fund.
That noodle stall you sent in the app looks close to the office. Is the pop-up actually today?
Yeah, their story says 5:30 at Canal Market. I saved the post so I can find it after our revision meeting.
If we get through the stakeholder notes by 4:45, I can do a quick stop.
Works. I also saw a small percussion set listed nearby, but food first.
Family dinner Saturday. Your uncle said he may open a bottle after food. You are okay driving back?
Yes, I will probably just have one with dinner or none. Subway is easy too.
Good. Also tell cousins to keep balcony stuff outside, not near your jacket this time.
Please do. Last time my coat smelled like their whole balcony setup.
Can you soak the chana Friday night if you come early? I need one more pair of hands before we leave Saturday morning.
Yes, I'll come after work and help pack the trays. Do you want me to bring the big steel container too?
Bring it. Also say hello properly when Uncle Suresh and Auntie Kamala arrive, they have not seen you in months.
I will. I'll make sure Dad doesn't carry all the heavy stuff by himself.
Your slide for the benefits rollout is way clearer after the grocery-receipt example.
Good. I may reuse that move for the 7th graders next Wednesday, just swap the receipt for MetroCard math.
Makes sense. They will get the percent-change thing faster if it starts with a fare jump.
Exactly. The hard part is removing the grown-up wording without making the idea fake.
Before your 10 AM meeting, check the lease portal. Sometimes March payments post late.
Already checked. My half cleared, roommate's is pending but scheduled.
Good. Your mother asked if Sunday the 15th works for lunch here.
Yes, I can come after the laundry pickup in Brooklyn.
Cafe table is ours next Friday. You still doing that noon bank-check ritual before games?
Yeah, quick look after lunch. The usual ~$2,150 should land, then I can Venmo for the snacks.
Perfect. Also wild that your first game night with us was right after that February 2024 onboarding week.
I remember showing up with the laptop bag and no idea how many deck builders you all owned.
Are you out early tomorrow for that park thing? I need to run laundry before noon.
Only if the rain holds off. Maya put me with the 8:00 pace set, but I still have slides to clean up tonight.
Got it. I'll keep the washer clear before 7 just in case.
Thanks. If I make it back from Prospect Park in time, I'll grab coffee filters too.
Can you survive one more round of stakeholder edits before lunch?
I split them into four tiny buckets and blocked 12:30-2:00. Screen is already making my temples throb, so I'm doing it in low brightness.
Good. Send me bucket 1 and 2 only. We can leave the messy wording for after coffee.
Deal. I'm taking one lap around the block first so I don't answer comments too fast.
Did you settle the Philly ticket? Check the return time carefully, Sunday delays can become a mess.
Yeah, I took the 7:40 bus back. It was $32 less than the train and still gets me home before midnight.
Good. Keep some cash aside for food there, not only the ride.
I added $45 for meals and transit. March is already tighter with the room deposit, so I am keeping it boring.
You were up early again? Eat something before opening all those work books.
I made eggs. Just doing one chapter and then the 20-minute bill check, no more.
Good. Set a timer and close it when it rings. You always keep adjusting after it is already fine.
Timer is on. I also moved the card payment to Friday so it lines up with payroll.
I moved your foam roller out of the hallway so I could vacuum.
FYI the super says the black bins behind the building are part of the pilot, so no loose bags after Tuesday.
Thanks. I need it after the loop by the park anyway, so I'll grab it when I'm back.
Good, I want to ask why our block got bins but the corner by the bus stop still has the bag mountain.
All good. Also your new sneakers box is still by the door.
Also the landlord left that rent notice downstairs. Is that tied to the rezoning flyer you had on the table?
I'll break those in gently today. Last week I overdid the extra miles.
Maybe. I am bringing both to the meeting, plus the bus shelter photos and the after-school funding sheet.
For game night, do you want the cafe near Atlantic or my place? Also I found that housing slate spreadsheet you asked about.
Cafe works. Send the sheet when you can, especially the council and comptroller notes.
It has tenant protections, transit funding, climate stuff, and who is taking matching funds.
Perfect. I want to compare before I fill out my sample ballot.
Doing Target after brunch. Need paper towels or foil?
Paper towels would help. I’m making containers after the wash finishes, so I’ll get the counters and sink after.
Got it. I’ll grab liners too and take the bags down tonight.
Thanks. I’ll leave the stove clean before you’re back.
Are you using both burners tonight? I need to make something quick before 8.
Only from 7:10 to maybe 7:45. Masoor, rice, small tadka pan. I can leave you the front burner.
Perfect. If there is extra, I will take a scoop.
There will be. I put the 10-minute bell on before starting so I should not be in the kitchen too long.
Your mother said you had the Brooklyn clinic visit. Did their portal update cleanly?
Yes, MyChart has the visit summary and the desk charged the normal $25.
Good. Save the PDF somewhere sensible, not only in email.
Already did. Dr. Mehta also linked the NYU page she wanted me to use for the spring timing question.
Coffee after the stakeholder check-in? I could use ten minutes away from slide comments.
Yes. 2:30 downstairs works. I have to leave on time tonight because Maya is picking up the big red box from my place.
The one with the planet board? I remember you carrying that thing through the office once.
Same one. Need to sort the cubes before people arrive or we'll lose twenty minutes.
Stakeholder notes just landed. Want to talk through them before tomorrow?
Yes, but give me a bit. I'm going to take the long way home and move first so I don't answer while buzzing.
Works. Coffee at 9:30 then? Bring whatever list you have after.
9:30 is good. If I still have legs after the park path, I'll make it concise.
Are you coming in for the room setup, or joining the first run-through from your place?
Coming in today. I want to see the room before the 10:30 group and fix the handouts there.
Good call. I blocked us until 5:30 so we can clean up the feedback notes after.
Thanks. If the launch deck gets one more revision, I may finish the last pass tonight.
Can you review v3 after work, or are you doing the Prospect Park miles tonight?
If the comments land before 5:30 I can still make the 7:00 PPR start. Otherwise I'll skip and send Maya a note.
I'll get my piece over by 4:45 so nobody is waiting on you there.
Appreciate it. They notice when someone bails last minute.
Are you carrying that little circuit kit again today? Use a separate pouch so the wires do not bend.
Already packed it. I also added a phone-charger example because the worksheet was too abstract.
Good. Start from what they already hold in their hands. Then show the diagram.
That is the plan. Last week the battery demo worked better once I stopped using the formal terms first.
You sounded tired on the phone. Did you eat dinner or only tea again?
Ate late. The launch list got big, so I wrote the next five things on paper and did the slow-count breathing before opening email.
Good. Also sleep early. Put the computer away if that tight feeling near your forehead starts.
I will. I made tomorrow a two-hour quiet block so I'm not bouncing between everything.
You mentioned a good write-up on passwordless logins. Send it when free.
Forwarded the email version. The app had a cleaner chart, but the inbox copy is easier to print.
Good. I want the chart, not someone's random comments under it.
Same. I saved the source note and the short explainer, no comment thread.
Did the March numbers settle? Keep the sheet simple: fixed lines first, variable items after.
Yeah. The fixed apartment line is 1,700, then I add power, internet, groceries, subway, and card stuff.
Good. If the room-size adjustment is already built in, do not recalculate every time.
Exactly. I only check the common bills when they post so we both send the right amount.
Beta, before work eat something warm. Not just coffee.
I will. Yesterday ran late so I was quiet.
Quiet is fine, but keep lunch in your bag and sleep before midnight. Call me tonight if the train is not too noisy.
Okay. I'll call after I get home, not in the family thread.
When you come Saturday, I found the little photo of you on the stoop with the lunchbox. You should take it.
The one from the old building? Keep it there for now. My shelves are already losing to board games.
Fine, but do not keep adding boxes if you may move again after this lease.
That is why I am not adding a couch-sized debt to the pile. Renewal packet first, big decisions later.
For Sunday lunch, should I keep the table simple or are you bringing someone with you?
Just me. I may bring the extra container back if we end up with leftovers at the apartment.
Okay, I will pack enough for you and one extra box for the other person there if you want.
That works. They are around this week and we have been trading off dinner cleanup.
Did you eat before going out so early this morning?
Beta, before your appointment Monday, make sure the card in your wallet is the new one.
I downloaded it from the portal. Copay looks normal, so I am keeping the 10:30 slot and working later.
Yes, banana first. I kept the Prospect Park loop short and stretched when I got home.
Good. Don't keep adding distance just because the weather is nice.
I know. This week is just Tue, Thu, and Saturday if everything feels normal.
Good. That place has been useful for letting you move hours when family or doctors come up.
That's honestly one of the reasons I have not rushed to change anything since the 2024 start.
Still on for games Saturday? Also I walked past Barclays and the whole plaza was blue lights.
Yeah, Saturday works. Blue lights make me feel two things at once: easier to cross that block, but my shoulders go up.
Same. Did anyone stop you at Foley last week?
No, just a bag-check table and a lot of metal fencing. I kept to the side and left before it got loud.
Are you using the big pan tonight? I need it after 8.
All yours by then. I'm finishing the pilaf and greens now.
The kitchen smells like cumin again. Any extra?
Yes, take the small container. There is ginger in the greens, so warm it gently.
Can we move the stakeholder prep to 9:15? I know you block early stuff pretty tightly.
9:15 works. I already did the ten-minute timer and packed leftover dal with rice, so I am good to start then.
Great. I will update the invite and bring the feedback list.
For the intern lunch, can you tell the story of how you ended up building modules instead of sitting with dashboards all day?
Sure, but I’ll keep it short. I had a little points table back then and the people-focused rows kept winning.
That is actually perfect. They keep asking how to think past the first title.
I can bring the sanitized version: compare the day-to-day work, money floor, and whether you can keep building skill.
Coffee tomorrow still work? I can bring the internal ladder doc from Priya's team.
Yes. I want to compare it with the ATD outline and see where my launch examples are thin.
Bring the onboarding redesign one. That has stakeholder notes, budget notes, and before-after data.
Perfect. I'm making myself stop at three examples tonight instead of rewriting the whole folder.
Sunday morning I am going to the hall on Hillside. If you come, cover your head there.
For the scan, use 300 dpi. My Punjab University final-year sheet has small print and the registrar seal fades.
I can make it after laundry. Should I bring the scarf from your car or use one from the basket?
Got it. I also found the Verizon bill from junior year with all three names on the account.
Use one there. Afterward we can meet your mother for the lamp thing at home.
Keep that with the school forms. Same address as the rent paperwork, before we moved the desk to your room.
Okay. I'll plan for both and keep the afternoon open.
I'll bring the portable scanner Sunday and label the files by year.
Did you finish the insurance portal? Keep the PDF copy in your folder.
Done. It was mostly confirming address, work info, and the same blank history page.
Good. Also check that they applied the wellness discount.
They did. No extra documentation needed, so I uploaded the receipt and closed it.
Did your upload finish? You said one site was refusing the package yesterday.
It finally went through in Canvas after I rebuilt the package. Moodle still needs the completion rule fixed.
Check the rule first, then the file. Usually the boring setting is the problem.
That was it. I also found two questions everyone is missing, so Monday’s edit list got longer.
Did you eat before going to that neighborhood meeting? You sounded tired on the phone.
Eating now. I stayed because the clinic hours item got buried under parking, and the school ventilation money was still vague.
Ask them to give dates, not just promises. People need to know when things actually start.
Exactly. Same with the bus-lane enforcement and the language-access forms for the tenant workshop.
Maya is coming from Queens next Sunday. If you come, I will make lemon rice and dal.
Did you eat after work? It sounded like a long day when you called.
I can come for lunch. Is it just you, Dad, me, and Maya?
Yes, the Indian place on Myrtle was faster than chopping anything.
Good. Keep some simple things at home also.
Yes, maybe her husband too. Same small table is enough.
Sounds easy. I'll bring fruit from the stand near the train.
I know. I already moved tomorrow's groceries to the smaller cart after seeing this week's charges.
Cafe has a table at 7 if we want games there. Too loud?
Cafe is fine. I can grab noodles on the way and still make it from Borough Hall without rushing.
Cafe says there may be a small set in the corner tonight. Still okay or should we move apartments?
Afterward I might walk toward the piers if the rain holds.
If we can hear each other, cafe is fine. I am mostly there for the game.
Same. Let's do one shorter game so there's time before it gets cold.
Fair. I will grab the big table by the window if it is open.
Saw you liked the photo from Hex & Co. Are we trying that cafe table next game night?
Maybe. One of the cardboard review accounts posted a short clip of Wyrmspan there and the lighting looked decent.
Send me that clip later. Also the flyer you forwarded for the tiny venue in Gowanus looked interesting.
Yeah, I saved both. We can decide after Saturday's game.
ConEd posted. Want me to request your half tonight or after you get back?
Tonight is fine. I moved the Philly cash already, so send the usual split.
Sent. Also are you taking the leftover pasta or should I finish it?
Take it. I packed oats and snacks so I do not keep buying random food there.
Are the containers in the fridge yours? Trying to figure out what shelf space is safe.
Mine. Mom sent extra lemon rice and dal after last weekend. You can have the smaller one if you want.
Thanks. Also are you out Sunday morning again? I can do kitchen floors then.
Yes, leaving around 9:20 for the gurdwara with Dad. I'll wipe the stove before I go.
For the pilot deck, where did you find that example with the heat map for learner drop-off?
From a saved post in my work feed, then the author had a longer writeup in yesterday's email roundup.
Coffee after the stakeholder call? Also, I found a tailor near Bryant Park if you still want the cuff fixed.
Send me both after lunch? That might help with the stakeholder slide.
Coffee yes. Tailor link helps. I am trying to make that pair last another month.
Will do. Also saw a posting at a museum using the same metrics language, which was interesting.
Fair. You mentioned the family November list already eating up a tab in your spreadsheet.
Exactly. I have the work stuff parked until the next paycheck clears.
Are you coming by after lunch or going straight home?
After lunch. I went down to Prospect first, so I'll be on the Q back up.
That is a lot of transit for a Saturday morning. Check the service changes.
Already did. The extra ride is worth it when I want more space than the neighborhood blocks.
I sent you the old address list. Use the Gurmukhi spelling for your chacha's lane, not the English one from Google.
Got it. I also added Mom's side in my notes, with the Hyderabad apartment and the Vijayawada stop.
Good. Keep both lists separate or the driver will be confused again like last time.
Last time was not my finest map work. This time I will color-code it before booking anything.
For April 14, leave Brooklyn by 7:15 if you are coming with us. Parking will be worse after 8.
I’ll meet you there. I already moved my morning call.
Good. Your mother also asked if you sent her the January photos.
Doing that today. I still have the November ones pinned first in the album.
I asked Jules and Priya. Looks like four confirmed for Thursday unless Maya gets out early.
Four is enough for Spirit Island. If Maya joins, we can still make it work.
Good. Cafe table by the window again? Their back room was too loud last time.
Window table. I'll reserve it for 6:45.
Ravi is bringing the tiny tin from last winter's party as a joke. Want me to keep it away from the main table?
Yeah, thanks. I am sticking to pizza and maybe one beer tonight.
Got it. I also saved you the chair farthest from the balcony door.
Perfect. I do not need my hoodie collecting everyone else's party choices.
BOE mail came for you. I left it by the microwave with the ConEd bill.
Thanks. Is it the address confirmation card or the primary notice?
Looks like dates and polling place. Same school on 5th Ave.
Good, I was worried the apartment renewal would mess that up.
I found another folder from the old office, mostly appointment slips and insurance copies. Do you want to look before I shred?
Yes, save it until Sunday. I can help sort the patient names from the blank sheets.
Your dad also kept a box of tiny screws and blue cables. He says don't throw those out.
Of course he does. I probably learned to treat cables like kitchen spoons because of him.
Did you eat after finishing? You said this week the new learning packet is going live.
I ate. I stayed on after 5:30 to fix the manager notes, but I am closing the laptop now.
Good. Tomorrow if you are at home, take a proper lunch break, not just tea.
Tomorrow is home, Wednesday I go in for the practice session.
Still good for games at Maya's on Friday, or are you doing the sore-arm thing again?
Still good. CVS slot is Thursday after work, so Friday should be fine.
Cool. We can keep it lighter if you show up moving one arm like a weird meeple.
Ha. I checked the NYU and CDC pages after Dr. Mehta mentioned the timing, so Thursday seems right.
Can you Venmo the Wi-Fi half tonight? I covered it when the autopay hit.
Yes, sending after I call my dad back. He pinged me during the training review.
Thanks. Also your mom's container is still on the top shelf if you want it before trash night.
Keeping it. I'll wash it after dinner and take trash down before 9.
Your mother said you sounded tired. Is the laptop still overheating during those long files?
Laptop is fine. Just a lot today. I texted Ravi instead of dumping it in the board-game thread.
Good. Finish one thing at a time. Also check the outlet near your desk; loose plugs create problems.
Will do. I'll call Ma after dinner.
Your uncle said the office asked you to speak on the March panel because you are 'good with numbers and quiet.' Odd compliment.
That's the problem. They make it sound harmless, then use it to decide who gets analysis work and who gets client-facing chances.
At our temple meeting, some people also talk about the newer families near Nostrand in a way I do not like.
Yeah. It is not just rude comments; it shapes who gets trusted, hired, watched, or ignored.
You sounded tired earlier. Did you eat something proper after work?
Yes, made plain rice and yellow dal. Kept it simple.
Good. Tomorrow morning sit quietly before checking office messages, okay?
I set the small bell for 6:50. Phone stays away until after.
For the launch retro, should I use the version from your old Feb 2024 template folder or the new stakeholder deck?
Use the new deck. That template folder is from my first month here and has too many weird placeholders.
Got it. Also HR posted the tiny year-end extra today, in case you track those with the $6,250 planning sheet.
Thanks. I will add it after tomorrow's deposit clears so March is not off by one line.
Coffee after the LMS review? I can do 2:15 near Bryant Park.
Works. I am also going to use the break to call the broker back about that tiny Park Slope place.
The one with the maintenance fee that made you close the tab?
That one. I keep comparing it to just renewing and leaving room for whatever comes after this project cycle.
Sunday program moved to the smaller hall. Parking will be bad, so come to our place by 8:30.
Ok. Should I print the sign-up sheet before I come?
Print two copies. Also call your Nani tonight, she asked whether you remembered her recipe.
I'll call after dinner. I wrote down the spice order last time so I should be fine.
Your father said you found the old file for Rohan. Good. Make sure you remove your private notes before sending.
Already copied it. I left the columns but deleted the comments where I was arguing with myself about data jobs.
You were worried then, but you were practical. You kept asking what would help people and still be steady.
That part stayed. Funny that the row with workshops and lesson plans beat the cleaner-looking analyst ones.
For tomorrow, should I bring chips or something real?
Bring lime wedges if you can. I'm trying the tortilla thing with chickpeas and onions.
The one with the yellow rice from last time?
Close, but less rice this time. More cumin, coriander, and a ginger-lime topping.
Still good hosting next Friday, or did the apartment math get annoying again?
Hosting is fine. The only annoying part is March trending closer to 3,400 because of the annual fee and extra groceries.
Oof. That's above your normal 3.1 to 3.3 zone, right?
Yeah. Apartment piece didn't change; just the add-ons and the ConEd bump.
I put the cafe poll in IG. Did you miss it again?
Probably. Send the final time here. I was buried in my saved articles and that habits book after work.
Sunday 2 at the Park Slope spot. Also bring whatever city-budget thing you were quoting last time.
Got it. I have the budget piece bookmarked from the city app roundup.
Are the Sunday lunch leftovers fair game or are you taking them to your parents?
You can have the extra dal. I'm taking the sweets because Maya asked for the Jackson Heights box.
Cool. Your family meals always sound compact compared with mine.
Usually it's just me and my parents unless someone from Queens or Jersey makes the trip.
You left your tablet on the kitchen table. Want me to move it?
Yes please, just put it by my desk. I had the saved posts open for tomorrow morning.
Done. Also saw your screen still had those opening alerts, so I locked it.
Thanks. I was trying to clear them before the newsletter backlog got worse.
For the refresher, do you want me to book Luis for 20 minutes or just send him the outline?
Book him. The Captivate version needs his process steps before I wire the decision points.
Got it. I will send him the intake answers too, especially the parts where supervisors disagreed.
Thanks. I am matching those to the first three screens so we do not build around the loudest request only.
I checked the Macy's sale you sent. The dress shirts are okay, but not special.
Then I'll wait. My older gray one can handle the next few office days.
What time should I reach your side tomorrow? I can take LIRR to Atlantic if easier.
Better to keep the larger November family items separate: outfits, boxes for relatives, food orders.
Atlantic is easiest. We can get dosas near the stop, then walk through Fort Greene before the 2:40 BAM show.
That's what I did. I put a small transfer on the 28th and left the shirts alone.
Good. No need for me to deal with parking there then.
